title: CGH Digitalization
description: Healthcare digitalization features supporting patient care workflows and clinical operations. Since March 2026, I've been working on CGH Digitalization, an AngularJS-based EMR (Electronic Medical Record) system, where I contribute to the Patient Care Plan module — including a draft-preservation system for shift logs and fluid intake/output automapping. I've led cross-browser compatibility efforts, resolving Firefox-specific issues across roughly ten EMR modules, and contributed to pagination systems, concurrency/stale-detection polling to prevent conflicting edits, role-based permission controls, and responsive layout work for tablet breakpoints. My stack includes AngularJS, RequireJS, SCSS (BEM), Bootstrap, and Docker.

title: MACEA Permit Processing System
description: A permit application platform built with Angular, TypeScript, PrimeNG, and ngx-permissions. I built data tables with frozen columns and role-based visibility, implemented audit logging, integrated REST APIs for permit retrieval, cancellation, and document downloads with server-side pagination, and developed responsive layouts for desktop and mobile.

title: Hapag Tanaw
description: Hapag Tanaw is a web-based restaurant table booking system designed to make reserving a table simple and hassle-free for both diners and restaurant staff. Built with Angular and TypeScript on the frontend, styled with Bootstrap for a clean and responsive interface, and powered by JSON-based data handling, the platform allows users to browse available tables, check real-time availability, and book a reservation in just a few clicks. The name Hapag Tanaw draws from Filipino words — hapag (table) and tanaw (view or sight) — reflecting the app's core purpose: giving users a clear view of what's available at the table before they even walk through the door.

title: Inventra
description: Inventra is a web-based Inventory & Warehouse Management System designed to help businesses efficiently monitor and manage their inventory within a single warehouse. The system provides a centralized dashboard for tracking product quantities, stock movements, low-stock items, and overall inventory valuation.The project is being developed following the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), starting with requirements analysis and UI/UX design before progressing toward frontend development, backend API integration, database implementation, and testing.

title: MESIMS
description: MESIMS (Meridian Elementary School Information Management System) is a full-stack school information management system built as a capstone project for Meridian Elementary School, designed to digitize and streamline administrative and academic workflows across six distinct user roles: Administrator, Principal, Registrar, Teacher, Parent, and Student. The system is built with compliance at its core, adhering to Philippine DepEd Order No. 8, s. 2015, including support for LRN (Learner Reference Number) tracking, PRC license verification for teachers, and the standard DepEd grading structure.

title: AquaLuminus
description: AquaLuminus is a full-stack IoT dashboard designed for monitoring and managing water quality parameters in real-time. The system integrates with various sensors to collect data on pH levels, temperature, dissolved oxygen, and other critical metrics. It provides a user-friendly interface for visualizing this data through interactive charts and graphs, enabling efficient decision-making for water resource management.
